annotations.text:
Flow: Card tap > Catch (under 2 seconds) > Ride, four phases > Outcome > Reward or Lapse.
Spec sections 7.2 to 7.6 and 7.12.
Ride shows two of four phases. Image (3 min) and Replace (remainder) are not drawn. Contrast is mandatory whenever Image runs.
Outcome branches: Beaten goes right to Reward. Used goes to Lapse. Partial returns home with the log kept.
Open on this canvas: how Change works on the Cue slot, whether the State dial belongs on Catch or only in Bookend sessions, and the Draw animation length inside the 1-second rule.
